SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-10-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF ALEX NADERI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT UNITED AIRLINES, INC. REPRESENTED BY JILL MOFFAT, CUSTOMER CARE MANGEIS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS SUBMITTED TO THE COURT FOR ZOOM APPEARANCE ARE RETAINED. PLAINTIFF STATES THAT HE DID RECEIVE A COPY OF DEFENDANTS EXHIBITS PRIOR TO TODAY TRIAL. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NADERI, ALEX RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT UNITED AIRLINES, INC. $2,050.00 PRINCIPAL, $65.00 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,115.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, FILED BY PLAINTIFF NADERI, ALEX AS TO DEFENDANT UNITED AIRLINES, INC.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED SEP-01-2021 ORDERED DESTROYED
